member.summary:
Current lifecycle status of the payment.
pending: The user has not yet completed the payment process.
approved: The payment has been approved and accredited.
authorized: The payment has been authorized but not captured yet.
in_process: Payment is being reviewed.
in_mediation: Users have initiated a dispute.
rejected: Payment was rejected. The user may retry payment.
cancelled: Payment was cancelled by one of the parties or because time for payment has expired.

member.name: T:MercadoPago.Webhook.WebhookSignatureValidator
member.summary: Verifies the authenticity of an incoming MercadoPago webhook notification by recomputing the HMAC-SHA256 signature locally and comparing it against the value in the x-signature header.
member.remarks:
This is a stateless, CPU-only utility. It performs no outbound HTTP calls and does not depend on MercadoPagoConfig; the integrator passes the secret signature explicitly on every call. The comparison is performed in constant time (via ) to mitigate timing attacks.
On failure, the validator throws with a specific . The integrator should respond with HTTP 401 to MercadoPago in all failure cases, log the for correlation, and not expose the failure reason in the HTTP response body.
QR Code notifications are not signed by MercadoPago — do not call this validator for those events; they will always fail signature verification.

member.name: M:MercadoPago.Webhook.WebhookSignatureValidator.Validate(System.String,System.String,System.String,System.String,System.Nullable{System.TimeSpan},System.Collections.Generic.IReadOnlyCollection{System.String})
member.summary: Validates the signature of a MercadoPago webhook notification.
member.param: The raw value of the x-signature request header. Expected to follow the format ts=<ms>,v1=<hex>.
The value of the x-request-id request header. Optional in the manifest: if null, empty, or whitespace, the request-id: pair is omitted before computing the HMAC.
The secret signature configured for the application in Tus Integraciones. Used as the HMAC key.
Optional maximum allowed drift between the timestamp in the header and . When null, no timestamp check is performed. Setting this to a small window (e.g. five minutes) mitigates replay attacks.

Optional ordered list of signature versions the SDK will accept. Defaults to {"v1"}. The validator iterates through this list and uses the first version found in the header, allowing forward compatibility with future signature schemes (e.g. v2) without breaking older integrations.
member.exception: Thrown when the signature is missing, malformed, or does not match the expected HMAC. Inspect for the specific failure mode.
Thrown when is null.
